technical.summary: Strong bullish technical confluence with multiple moving average and momentum confirmations, but extreme overbought conditions and weak trend strength create elevated pullback risk for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: AMGN shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 76 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (9/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but mixed congressional activity (small trades, no senior conviction) and unavailable news sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX at crisis levels (400.8), flat yield curve signals recession risk, rising USD pressures multinational earnings, and earnings event in 76 days adds execution risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong technical confluence (RSI extreme overbought, Ichimoku TK cross-up, 10-day new high) with extreme fear sentiment (9/100) creates contrarian buy opportunity at support zone (215.62).
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis at 400.8, flat yield curve, rising USD), extreme overbought conditions with weak trend strength (ADX false), zero fundamental conviction, and upcoming earnings in 76 days create unacceptable risk/reward for swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical setup shows strong bullish confluence at support with extreme fear sentiment creating contrarian opportunity. However, severe macro headwinds, extreme overbought conditions with weak trend confirmation, and zero fundamental conviction make risk/reward unacceptable for new swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis levels (400.8) combined with flat yield curve recession signal and upcoming earnings in 76 days create macro execution risk that outweighs technical setup strength.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical and sentiment agents bullish, but fundamental and risk agents strongly bearish; debate winner correctly identifies bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Existing AMGN position plus 43 open Health Care positions (26% of portfolio) create sector concentration risk; high portfolio volatility environment argues against adding exposure despite technical setup.
